land_cover.name: USGS NLCD 2021 Land Cover L48
land_cover.terms: USGS public-domain data; cite MRLC / USGS

buildings.name: OpenStreetMap height-tagged closed building ways
buildings.height_method: Explicit height tag, converted feet to meters when present. No levels-to-height estimates. Not validated as measured LiDAR heights.
buildings.coverage: Selective 526 buildings; excludes untagged footprints, relations and building:part-only geometries.

lidar_investigation.reason: Strip sample LAZ tiles are 525–755 MB each; avoid bulk download / unreliable DSM minus DTM processing. No local PDAL installed. DEM and explicit OSM height fallback used.

terrain.name: Esri Terrain 3D
terrain.terms: Esri Master License Agreement; stream only, no offline tile export
terrain.coverage_date: Multi-source, variable acquisition dates; not verified as Clark County LiDAR

imagery.name: Esri World Imagery
imagery.terms: Esri Master License Agreement; stream only, no tile redistribution
imagery.coverage_date: Mosaic; variable acquisition dates, not synchronous with NLCD or OSM

places.name: US Census BAS 2026 incorporated cities and Census designated places

topographic_basemap.name: Esri World Topographic Map
topographic_basemap.terms: Esri Master License Agreement; stream only, retain contributor attribution

cinematic_analysis.boundary: Existing NLCD 2021 500 m grid developed footprint, largest connected component exterior

selected_location.name: Eastern Sunrise Manor / Frenchman Mountain transition

cinematic_analysis.site_evaluation: Compared three Esri imagery previews; refined latitude using NLCD west/east zonal contrast
cinematic_analysis.reveal_method: Distance bands originate at selected real eastern edge; 75 m near it, coarser farther away; intersected with whole urban footprint and local desert polygon. No silver line.
cinematic_analysis.buffer_approximation: 128 segments per quadrant, simplified by at most 0.5 m before shared ring differences; independently tested within 2 m. Original developed footprint and border unchanged.
cinematic_analysis.imagery_previews: Local source cache only, not redistributed with site
cinematic_analysis.distant_globe_surface: Reference ellipsoid above 2000 km camera altitude avoids polar terrain cap artifact; real DEM below that altitude.

globe_imagery.name: NASA GIBS BlueMarble_ShadedRelief_Bathymetry
globe_imagery.coverage: Global satellite composite; not current-date photography
globe_imagery.method: Direct WMS download; no AI imagery or image synthesis

historical_source.temporal_warning: Five-year model estimates, not independent observed footprints; 2020 source-extrapolated from 2018.
